function.name: TodoWrite
function.description: Save investigation tasks to break down complex problems into manageable sub-tasks. ALWAYS provide the COMPLETE list of all tasks, not just the ones being updated.

todos.description: COMPLETE list of ALL tasks on the task list. Each task should have: id (string), content (string), status (pending/in_progress/completed/failed)

function.name: cdevents_timeline_request
function.description: Make HTTP requests to cdevents-timeline API (2 hosts)

max_depth.description: Maximum JSON nesting depth to return. Must be >= 1 (e.g. 1 keeps only the top-level structure, 3 keeps three levels). Omit this parameter for the full response. For precise field extraction prefer the `jq` parameter. Do NOT pass 0 or negative values — they return no usable data.

jq.description: Optional jq expression to extract specific parts of the JSON. Supports full jq syntax including filters, slicing, transformations, and more (e.g., '.items[] | select(.price > 10)', '.items[0:5]', '.items[].name').

url.description: The full URL to request (must match a whitelisted endpoint)

method.description: HTTP method (default: GET). Must be allowed by the endpoint configuration.

body.description: Request body (JSON string) for POST/PUT/PATCH requests

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers as a JSON object (optional, overrides defaults)
